title: 生態滯留雨水花園~Bioretention rain gardens
focus: 從街道逕流到雨水花園的滯留與處理~Detention and treatment from street runoff to rain gardens
summary: 以「從街道逕流到雨水花園的滯留與處理」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow detention and treatment from street runoff to rain gardens through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 逕流體積~Runoff volume
units.mechanism: 不透水面積與有效降雨決定進入花園的體積；逕流係數是事件近似。~Impervious area and effective rainfall set incoming volume; a runoff coefficient is an event approximation.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：V=C P A;C=0.9;P=0.03 m;A=1000 m2；計算 0.9*0.03*1000 = 27 m3。適用限制：未模擬時間分布。~Original hypothetical teaching example: V=C P A;C=0.9;P=0.03 m;A=1000 m2; calculation 0.9*0.03*1000 = 27 m3. Applicability: No time distribution modeled.
units.verify: 把面積分成屋頂與道路並分別估逕流。~Separate roof and road areas and estimate runoff independently.
units.failure: 只以花園自身面積算雨量會漏掉外來匯流。~Using garden area alone omits external runoff.
units.misconception: 雨水花園只接收落在自己面積上的雨。~A rain garden receives only rainfall on its own area.
units.practice: 在「逕流體積」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 27 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只以花園自身面積算雨量會漏掉外來匯流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for runoff volume, first reproduce 27 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using garden area alone omits external runoff." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 入口截流能力~Inlet interception
units.mechanism: 道路邊溝水流不一定全部進入開口，入口坡度、堵塞和旁通需分開表示。~Not all gutter flow enters an opening; represent slope, blockage and bypass separately.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：captured volume=f V;f=0.8;V=27；計算 0.8*27 = 21.6 m3。適用限制：假想固定截流率。~Original hypothetical teaching example: captured volume=f V;f=0.8;V=27; calculation 0.8*27 = 21.6 m3. Applicability: Hypothetical fixed interception fraction.
units.verify: 減半入口開口並觀察旁通比例。~Halve the inlet opening and observe bypass fraction.
units.failure: 把總逕流當全部入園會高估實際處理量。~Assuming all runoff enters overstates treated volume.
units.misconception: 只要設一個入口就能截住全部道路逕流。~One inlet captures all road runoff.
units.practice: 在「入口截流能力」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 21.6 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把總逕流當全部入園會高估實際處理量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for inlet interception, first reproduce 21.6 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Assuming all runoff enters overstates treated volume." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 表面滯留深度~Surface ponding depth
units.mechanism: 表面容量由有效平面積與可用水深決定，邊坡與自由高需另列。~Surface storage depends on effective area and usable depth; side slopes and freeboard are separate.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：V=A h;A=80 m2;h=0.2 m；計算 80*0.2 = 16 m3。適用限制：矩形容量近似。~Original hypothetical teaching example: V=A h;A=80 m2;h=0.2 m; calculation 80*0.2 = 16 m3. Applicability: Rectangular storage approximation.
units.verify: 改變花園有效面積並繪出容量。~Vary effective garden area and plot storage.
units.failure: 把自由高也算進日常容量可能消耗溢流保護。~Counting freeboard as routine storage consumes overflow protection.
units.misconception: 所有邊緣高度都可當作正常滯留水深。~All edge height can count as normal ponding depth.
units.practice: 在「表面滯留深度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 16 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把自由高也算進日常容量可能消耗溢流保護。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for surface ponding depth, first reproduce 16 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Counting freeboard as routine storage consumes overflow protection." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 介質可排水孔隙~Drainable media pores
units.mechanism: 介質蓄水取決於可排水孔隙而非總孔隙；已有水分會占用容量。~Media storage depends on drainable rather than total porosity; antecedent water occupies capacity.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：V=A d nd;A=80;d=0.5;nd=0.15；計算 80*0.5*0.15 = 6 m3。適用限制：均質介質。~Original hypothetical teaching example: V=A d nd;A=80;d=0.5;nd=0.15; calculation 80*0.5*0.15 = 6 m3. Applicability: Homogeneous medium.
units.verify: 比較乾期與連續雨期的孔隙容量。~Compare pore storage after dry and repeated-rain periods.
units.failure: 使用總孔隙率會把不可排水部分重複計入。~Total porosity overcounts non-drainable water.
units.misconception: 總孔隙率與可排水孔隙率永遠相同。~Total and drainable porosity are always equal.
units.practice: 在「介質可排水孔隙」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 6 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「使用總孔隙率會把不可排水部分重複計入。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for drainable media pores, first reproduce 6 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Total porosity overcounts non-drainable water." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 入滲與退水~Infiltration and drawdown
units.mechanism: 退水速率受最慢土層、地下水與水頭影響；表面無水不代表介質已恢復容量。~Drawdown depends on the slowest layer, groundwater and head; a dry surface does not mean restored media storage.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：time=V/(f A);V=16;f=0.01 m/h;A=80；計算 16/(0.01*80) = 20 h。適用限制：固定入滲率，未含底排。~Original hypothetical teaching example: time=V/(f A);V=16;f=0.01 m/h;A=80; calculation 16/(0.01*80) = 20 h. Applicability: Constant infiltration rate without underdrain.
units.verify: 將入滲率減半，檢查下一場雨前是否退水。~Halve infiltration and check drawdown before the next storm.
units.failure: 只量表土入滲可能漏掉下方低滲層。~Surface testing can miss a less permeable lower layer.
units.misconception: 表土滲得快就代表整個剖面都滲得快。~Fast surface infiltration guarantees a permeable whole profile.
units.practice: 在「入滲與退水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 20 h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只量表土入滲可能漏掉下方低滲層。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for infiltration and drawdown, first reproduce 20 h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Surface testing can miss a less permeable lower layer." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 底排與尾水~Underdrain and tailwater
units.mechanism: 底排流量受下游水位影響；淹沒出口時不能沿用自由出流能力。~Underdrain discharge depends on tailwater; submerged outlets cannot use free-outflow capacity.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：net head=h_up-h_down;0.30-0.18；計算 0.30-0.18 = 0.12 m。適用限制：只算可用水頭。~Original hypothetical teaching example: net head=h_up-h_down;0.30-0.18; calculation 0.30-0.18 = 0.12 m. Applicability: Available head only.
units.verify: 提高下游水位並比較水頭與排水。~Raise tailwater and compare head and discharge.
units.failure: 下游暴雨同時頂托會延長花園積水。~Storm tailwater can prolong ponding.
units.misconception: 底排管只要存在就永遠能自由排水。~An underdrain always flows freely merely because it exists.
units.practice: 在「底排與尾水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.12 m，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「下游暴雨同時頂托會延長花園積水。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for underdrain and tailwater, first reproduce 0.12 m, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Storm tailwater can prolong ponding." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 顆粒截留與前池~Solids capture and forebay
units.mechanism: 前池先攔較粗顆粒，保護主介質；需以質量負荷而非濁度單點排維護。~A forebay captures coarse solids and protects media; base maintenance on mass load rather than one turbidity reading.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：captured solids=C V eta;C=0.15 kg/m3;V=21.6;eta=0.6；計算 0.15*21.6*0.6 = 1.944 kg/event。適用限制：假想事件平均濃度。~Original hypothetical teaching example: captured solids=C V eta;C=0.15 kg/m3;V=21.6;eta=0.6; calculation 0.15*21.6*0.6 = 1.944 kg/event. Applicability: Hypothetical event-mean concentration.
units.verify: 比較前池清理前後入口沉積位置。~Compare deposition before and after forebay cleaning.
units.failure: 前池滿載會把沉積物重新帶入介質。~A full forebay can remobilize sediment into media.
units.misconception: 截留的固體會自行消失而不需清除。~Captured solids disappear without removal.
units.practice: 在「顆粒截留與前池」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.944 kg/event，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「前池滿載會把沉積物重新帶入介質。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for solids capture and forebay, first reproduce 1.944 kg/event, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A full forebay can remobilize sediment into media." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 養分與介質釋出~Nutrients and media release
units.mechanism: 介質可吸附也可釋出養分；有機質增加不一定提高所有出流水質。~Media can retain or release nutrients; adding organic matter does not improve every water-quality measure.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：net export=Qout Cout-Qin Cin;Qout=15,Cout=0.3,Qin=20,Cin=0.1；計算 15*0.3-20*0.1 = 2.5 g/event。適用限制：C以mg/L、Q以m3；乘積為g。~Original hypothetical teaching example: net export=Qout Cout-Qin Cin;Qout=15,Cout=0.3,Qin=20,Cin=0.1; calculation 15*0.3-20*0.1 = 2.5 g/event. Applicability: C in mg/L and volume in m3 yield grams.
units.verify: 比較新介質與沖洗後介質的溶解磷。~Compare dissolved phosphorus from fresh and conditioned media.
units.failure: 只報總流量降低會漏掉濃度上升造成的養分輸出。~Volume reduction can hide nutrient export caused by higher concentration.
units.misconception: 所有綠色介質都只會吸附不會釋出污染物。~All green media only adsorb and never release pollutants.
units.practice: 在「養分與介質釋出」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 2.5 g/event，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報總流量降低會漏掉濃度上升造成的養分輸出。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for nutrients and media release, first reproduce 2.5 g/event, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Volume reduction can hide nutrient export caused by higher concentration." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 溢流與安全通路~Overflow and safe routing
units.mechanism: 超過容量的雨水需走預定路徑；控制溢流位置比宣稱不溢流更可驗證。~Excess rainfall needs a planned route; overflow location is more verifiable than a claim of no overflow.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：overflow=Vin-storage-infiltration;Vin=40;storage=22;infiltration=5；計算 40-22-5 = 13 m3。適用限制：單事件桶模型。~Original hypothetical teaching example: overflow=Vin-storage-infiltration;Vin=40;storage=22;infiltration=5; calculation 40-22-5 = 13 m3. Applicability: Single-event bucket model.
units.verify: 用超設計事件追蹤溢流是否進入行人通道。~Track overflow during an extreme teaching event and check pedestrian paths.
units.failure: 入口堵塞或邊界破口會形成非預定水路。~Blocked inlets or boundary breaches create unintended flow paths.
units.misconception: 雨水花園能完全消除所有洪水。~Rain gardens eliminate every flood.
units.practice: 在「溢流與安全通路」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 13 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「入口堵塞或邊界破口會形成非預定水路。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for overflow and safe routing, first reproduce 13 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Blocked inlets or boundary breaches create unintended flow paths." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 事件監測與維護觸發~Event monitoring and maintenance triggers
units.mechanism: 以退水時間、入出流與照片建立趨勢；維護觸發值須依場址設計而定。~Track drawdown, flows and photos; maintenance triggers depend on the site design.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：relative drawdown increase=(30-20)/20；計算 (30-20)/20 = 0.5 fraction。適用限制：假想前後比較，非通用維護門檻。~Original hypothetical teaching example: relative drawdown increase=(30-20)/20; calculation (30-20)/20 = 0.5 fraction. Applicability: Hypothetical before/after comparison, not a universal trigger.
units.verify: 保持相似雨量比較兩季退水曲線。~Compare seasonal drawdown curves under similar storms.
units.failure: 不控制降雨條件就比較退水時間會誤判堵塞。~Comparing drawdown without storm control can misdiagnose clogging.
units.misconception: 兩場雨的退水不同就一定是設備損壞。~Different drawdown in two storms always means damage.
units.practice: 在「事件監測與維護觸發」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.5 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「不控制降雨條件就比較退水時間會誤判堵塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for event monitoring and maintenance triggers, first reproduce 0.5 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Comparing drawdown without storm control can misdiagnose clogging." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
